title.zh: 皮影戏上台，第二幕动线定稿
title.en: The shadow play goes live, and Act 2 is mapped out

summary.zh: 十幕皮影戏从测试房搬进正式关卡；第二幕的剧情动线写成了完整文档。
summary.en: The ten-act shadow play moved from a test room into the real level, and Act 2's story flow is now fully documented.

title.zh: 重做梦隙，加入走廊追逐
title.en: Reworking DreamGap, adding a corridor chase

summary.zh: 梦隙改成按住消耗的能量模型，并围绕它做了第一段追逐关卡。
summary.en: DreamGap became a hold-to-use energy model, and the first chase level was built around it.

summary.zh: 从基础系统到四个院落、一个内室，第一版可以从头玩到尾的 Demo。
summary.en: From base systems to four courtyards and an interior: the first demo you can play from start to finish.
